guarantees: V1-V4 are immutable and guarded by automated hashes.
Reconciliation is digest-bound and does not rewrite source definitions, releases, sessions, mutations, or submissions.
Tenantless forms and release-less sessions are quarantined without inferred relationships.
New respondent sessions persist and verify a SHA-256 secret digest; acknowledged V3-only sessions are verified against the retained token once, then lazily backfilled and verified through the digest.
